static.privacyLocalNote: This demo portal does not send your data to any server. Your account, reading history, bookmarks, and wallet are stored only in your browser's local storage, on your device.
static.privacySeoDesc: How SoftGate Comic handles your data: everything stays in your browser's local storage — nothing is sent to servers or shared with third parties.
static.informationWeCollectDesc: We keep only what the portal needs to work: the account details you enter and your reading activity. All of it stays in your browser's local storage and is never transmitted to us.
static.personalInfoDesc: The name, email, and username you enter when creating your demo account. These stay on your device.
static.usageDataDesc: Settings such as your language choice and reading preferences. We do not run analytics or tracking of any kind.
static.readingActivityDesc: Your reading history, bookmarks, and likes are saved so features like Continue Reading and your Library work. This activity stays on your device and is never uploaded or shared.
static.howWeUseDesc: Your information is used on your device for the following purposes:
static.useProvide: To provide portal features such as sign-in, Library, and Continue Reading
static.useImprove: To remember your preferences between visits
static.useSecurity: To keep your demo session secure on this device
static.dataSharingDesc: We do not share your data with anyone. On this demo portal your data never leaves your device, so there is nothing to sell, transfer, or disclose to third parties.
static.dataSecurityDesc: Your data lives in your browser's local storage and is protected by your device. No copies exist on our servers because nothing is transmitted.
static.yourRightsDesc: You are in full control. Clearing your browser's site data deletes everything SoftGate Comic has stored — account, reading history, bookmarks, and wallet. You can also log out or remove individual items in the app at any time.
static.childrenPrivacyDesc: SoftGate Comic is intended for users aged 13 and above. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If a child has entered information, clearing the browser's site data removes it completely.
static.contactUsDesc: If you have questions, contact us at support@softgatecomic.com.
static.termsSeoDesc: Terms of use for SoftGate Comic: eligibility, content license, Coins and virtual items, comments, and account rules.
static.acceptanceTermsDesc: By using this service, you agree to these terms.
static.eligibilityDesc: You must be at least 13 years old to use SoftGate Comic. If you are between 13 and 18, you may only use the service under the supervision of a parent or legal guardian who agrees to these terms.
static.useLicenseDesc: SoftGate Comic contains proprietary and licensed content. You receive a personal, non-transferable license to read it within the service — ownership is never transferred to you.
static.prohibitedScrape: Scrape, bulk-download, or re-upload webtoon episodes to other sites or apps
static.userAccountsDesc: You are responsible for your account security.
static.userContentDesc: Comments you post remain yours. By posting, you allow SoftGate Comic to display them within the service, and we may remove comments that are abusive, unlawful, or spam. On this demo portal, comments are stored only in your browser.
static.intellectualPropertyDesc: Content on this service is owned by SoftGate Comic and licensors.
static.premiumContentDesc: Premium episodes require Coins to unlock. Once unlocked, an episode stays readable on the device where you unlocked it.
static.coinsVirtualDesc: Coins are a virtual currency used to unlock premium episodes. Coins are licensed to you, not sold:
static.coinsNoOwnership: You do not own Coins — they are a limited, non-transferable license tied to your account
static.coinsNoValue: Coins have no real-world monetary value and cannot be redeemed for cash
static.coinsNoTransfer: Coins cannot be sold, gifted, or transferred to another account or person
static.coinsDemo: On this demo portal, Coin top-ups are simulated — no real payment is taken and no refunds apply
static.terminationDesc: We may terminate accounts that violate these terms.
static.limitationDesc: SoftGate Comic is not liable for any losses related to the service.
static.governingLawDesc: These terms are governed by Myanmar law.
static.cookiesSeoDesc: SoftGate Comic uses no tracking cookies. Learn what this demo portal stores in your browser's local storage and how to clear it.
static.noCookiesNote: SoftGate Comic does not set any tracking cookies. This page describes the browser local storage the demo portal actually uses.
static.whatAreCookiesDesc: Cookies are small files sent by websites to your device. Local storage is a similar browser feature that keeps data on your device without sending it anywhere.
static.howWeUseCookiesDesc: We do not use cookies at all. This demo portal uses your browser's local storage to run essential features — sign-in, wallet, Library, and reading progress — entirely on your device:
static.essentialCookiesDesc: Entries required for core features: your demo account session and Coin wallet. Without them, sign-in and premium unlocking cannot work.
static.functionalCookiesDesc: Entries that remember your choices: language, Library, bookmarks, reading progress, comments, notifications, recent searches, and reading preferences.
static.analyticsCookiesDesc: None. SoftGate Comic does not use analytics cookies, scripts, or any usage tracking on this demo portal.
static.marketingCookiesDesc: None. There are no advertising or marketing cookies, pixels, or trackers of any kind.
static.storageDetails: What We Store In Your Browser
static.storageDetailsDesc: Every entry is essential or functional. Nothing is used for tracking, profiling, or advertising.
static.storageSessionDesc: Keeps you signed in to your demo account.
static.storageWalletDesc: Your demo Coin balance and top-up history.
static.storageProgressDesc: Reading history and scroll position for Continue Reading.
static.storageCommentsDesc: Comments you have written on episodes.
static.storageNotificationsDesc: Your in-app notification list and read state.
static.storageSearchesDesc: Your latest search terms for quick re-search.
static.storageReadabilityDesc: Text size and contrast choices on legal pages.
static.managingCookiesDesc: You can clear everything at any time from your browser settings (Clear site data). Doing so signs you out and resets your wallet, Library, reading history, and preferences.
static.thirdPartyCookiesDesc: None. This demo portal loads no third-party cookies, trackers, or embedded advertising services.
static.updatesPolicyDesc: We may update this policy as the product evolves — for example, when a real backend replaces local storage. Material changes will appear on this page with a new date.

about.ourStoryDesc: SoftGate Comic began in 2026 as a Myanmar-first webtoon portal — still early, still honest about what ships today.
about.ourMissionDesc: To present Myanmar literature and culture through modern webtoon format.
about.ourVisionDesc: A production-ready home for Myanmar webtoons — real APIs, real creator tools, and a reading community that grows beyond this demo.
about.valuesDeck: The principles that guide our everyday work and growth
about.valueQualityDesc: A small, curated catalog we can stand behind — every title in the demo is chosen, not scraped.
about.valueCommunityDesc: Comments, library, and discovery built into one portal so readers and creators can meet in one place.
about.valueCreatorsDesc: A creator-first roadmap: fair terms and real publishing tools are the goal as the platform grows.
about.valueInnovationDesc: A lightweight, fast portal that works well on everyday devices and connections in Myanmar.
about.joinUsDesc: Join SoftGate Comic and build the Myanmar webtoon world together.

creators.step1Desc: Get a series title, a short synopsis that hooks readers, a genre, and a portrait cover image ready.
creators.step2Desc: Export your episodes as vertical-scroll image files and make sure they match the format checklist below.
creators.step3Desc: Send us a message through the Contact page. Our admin team reviews every submission and replies with next steps.
creators.spec1: Episode artwork as vertical-scroll JPG or PNG images
creators.spec2: A portrait cover (3:4) that works as a book cover
creators.spec3: A series title, genre, and a synopsis of a few sentences
creators.spec4: At least 3 finished episodes ready for launch
creators.lookFor1: Stories that fit our catalog genres — Action, Romance, Fantasy, Drama, and more
creators.lookFor2: Consistent artwork and a release schedule you can maintain
creators.lookFor3: Original work that you own the rights to
creators.ctaDesc: We review every series personally. Tell us about your webtoon and we will get back to you with next steps.
creators.legalNote: Please do not send unsolicited files directly — start with a message through the Contact page.

faq.noResultsDesc: Try another term, or reach us via
faq.a1: SoftGate Comic is a webtoon service for Myanmar readers.
faq.q2: Is SoftGate Comic free to use?
faq.a2: Yes, SoftGate Comic has many free webtoons. Only premium episodes require coins.
faq.a3: SoftGate Comic can be used on computers, tablets, and mobile phones.
faq.q4: How do I create an account?
faq.a4: You can create an account with email and password on the registration page.
faq.q5: What if I forget my password?
faq.a5: Password reset by email is not available yet in this demo portal. While signed in, you can change your password from Profile → Security. If you are locked out, create a new demo account on this device.
faq.a6: Yes, you can delete your account in the profile page.
faq.a7: Select a package on the coins page and choose a payment method.
faq.a8: This demo portal uses a demo coin top-up only — no real payments are processed yet. Methods like MMQR and cards arrive with the production release.
faq.a10: New webtoon releases vary by author schedule.
faq.q11: How do I request a webtoon?
faq.a11: You can contact us to make a request.
faq.q12: How do I unlock premium episodes?
faq.a12: Premium episodes are unlocked with coins from your wallet. Open the episode list on a series page and choose a Premium episode to unlock it.
faq.a13: Your reading progress is saved on this browser. The Home page shows a Continue Reading rail so you can resume the exact episode where you left off.
faq.q14: Can I publish my own webtoon on SoftGate Comic?
faq.a14: Yes — see the Publish with Us page for format requirements and how to reach our team about your series.
